sources.role: Primary conceptual description of cube sizing, starting point, keyed three-coordinate point generation, data entry, rotation, export, decryption, padding, multiple cubes, Nested Cubes, and Crossword split-key masking.
Four-by-four visual face-projection example and legacy reference fixture.

advancedConcepts: Random or sampled junk data for incomplete blocks
Multiple cube blocks for large inputs

legacySpreadsheetFixture.status: Preserved as the 4x4 visual demonstration fixture. It is not the standard known-text control because its original coordinate-key mapping has not been reconstructed or supplied.

normalizedImplementationModel.minimumGridRationale: A 2x2 model is too small to demonstrate the three-axis Binary Cube structure and is rejected as equivalent in practical complexity to a simple Latin-cipher-sized model.
normalizedImplementationModel.projectionRequirement: Unique x-y, x-z, and y-z coordinate pairs
normalizedImplementationModel.validEncryptedExit: One of the four faces perpendicular to the input face
normalizedImplementationModel.maskMeaning: Key-held boolean selection over input-face cells
normalizedImplementationModel.paddingMeaning: Deterministic seeded junk bits for inactive or unused cells
normalizedImplementationModel.packageChecksum: FNV-1a 32-bit corruption detection over framing metadata and ciphertext
normalizedImplementationModel.checksumLimitation: Not cryptographic authentication and not evidence of secrecy or authorship

standardKnownTextControl.requiredResult: exact binary byte and UTF-8 text recovery

customEditorModel.draftIsolation: The active key is not changed until the draft validates and is explicitly applied.
customEditorModel.compatibilityRule: Applying a changed key clears the package and decrypted output because prior packages require the prior key.
customEditorModel.largeGridBehavior: Text editing and active/inactive summary without rendering an unbounded cell grid.

authenticatedTransportModel.purpose: Optional confidentiality and authenticated transport for a validated serialized Binary Cube package
authenticatedTransportModel.separationRule: The standard cryptographic envelope is separate from and does not validate the security of the experimental cube permutation
